learning_outcomes.text: Understand and compute derivatives and interpret the corresponding result.
Understand and determine linear and higher order approximations.
Understand and explicitly compute the antiderivative of some elementary functions.
Understand and apply the fundamental theorem of differential calculus and the fundamental theorem of integral calculus.
Understand (and compute) integrals as well as their applications.
Understand and apply some simple numerical methods to obtain solutions of nonlinear equations and to compute approximate values of derivatives and integrals.
Understand numerical series and determine the power series representation of some functions.

syllabus_topics: Numerical methods: bisection and Newton's methods

assessment_methods.method: Continuous Assessment - Option A: Two written tests
Continuous Assessment - Option A: Class participation
Continuous Assessment - Option B: One written test
Continuous Assessment - Option B: Class participation
Continuous Assessment for Working Student Status: Two written tests

assessment_rules: The minimum passing grade for the course unit is 10 out of 20. For Continuous Assessment - Option A, a minimum grade of 8.0 out of 20 is required in each of the two written tests. For Continuous Assessment - Option B, a minimum grade of 8.0 out of 20 is required for the written test. The Course Unit Coordinator may require an additional in-person oral examination for any assessment component.
